#Hello, {NICKNAME}! Are you here to decipher your fortune slip today?
(Hands over the fortune slip) In the middle of a hazy night.
"Cloudy."
Here. Your strip of paper.
Goodbye.
Goodbye.

#(Hey, {NICKNAME}!)
(According to that Ms. Gendou, this Ms. Gendou is...)
(Yeah, a Fatui knockoff.)
Ah, we meet again. Want to check your fortune as well? Or...
If you need a listening ear or if you have something to discuss, I can help too.
We're just passing through.
Ms. Gendou is so friendly!
Is that so? Hehe, that's what many people have told me lately. It feels good.
It's always been my dream to work at a beautiful shrine like this.
(Yeah, she's a Fatui knockoff.)
(Still, she seems like she actually enjoys this job.)
(Don't let your guard down.)
#So {NICKNAME}, how may I help you today?
I'm just here to see you.
Me... Huh? Ah? S—Sorry, I don't understand what you... what you mean...
P—Please allow me to cool down a little...
It's nothing.
I get it now. Come find me if you have any questions.
(Wait for Ms. Gendou to contact us.)
No, thanks!

Ah, I'm sorry. "No such thing" exists at the moment.
You are so reliable... If only the F...
Fatui?
Uh... I mean, "If only I, the foolish Gendou Ringo, could witness your prowess in combat!"
...You will someday, don't worry.
About the strip of paper...
Oh, you mean the Fortune Slip? It works like this.
First, you have to shake the Fortune Slip box till a Bamboo Slip falls out. Then, give me the Bamboo Slip and I will give the corresponding Fortune Slip to you.
If it is an inauspicious fortune, you can knot it on the Fortune Slip Hanger to turn bad luck into good luck... That's about all there is to it.
You know so much.
Well, after all, these are... the basic skills of a shrine maiden!
Give the Special Bamboo Slip
Alright, please pass that Bamboo Slip to me... Huh, actually, you know what? I have the faintest impression that you didn't shake the slip cylinder at all.
Really? Must've been a trick of the light.
That's right. You just weren't paying attention, Ms. Gendou.
M—Me? Not paying attention? C—Come now, that... that never happened. I just didn't sleep so well last night, that's all. Sorry for worrying you!
Here's your Fortune Slip.
(How did it go? We should've gotten the powder onto her, right?)
(Without a hitch, Paimon.)
Um, why are you two standing there while looking so somber? Did you get a slip with Misfortune on it?
No, just a Modest Fortune.
Oh, I wouldn't be too sad about that. A Modest Fortune is not bad, either. Perhaps you might encounter some challenges, but I'm sure that there's a happy ending waiting for you on the other side.
Someone with a heart as good as yours will definitely see such fortunes through. Well, that's what I believe, at least.
How've things been going lately?
Thanks for your concern. I'm feeling great, really! That I was able to become a real shrine maiden is thanks to your help, and that of many others.
I will stay here, and I will pray for you all in earnest. If you ever have something on your mind, I'll be happy to hear you out.
Have you heard anything from Momoyo?
I fear that Ms. Momoyo had already left by the time I returned to this place, so I missed the opportunity to thank her in person.
Still, I believe that we will meet again in future.
See you around.
See you! May your day be blessed.
Hey, Ms. Gendou?
#...O—Oh, why, hello, {NICKNAME}! Are you here to decipher your fortune slip today?
In the middle of a hazy night.
Ah, I'm sorry. "No such thing" exists at the moment.
It's been a while since there's been anything, eh?
Um, th—that has been case, hasn't it? And perhaps there won't be any in the future ever again, really...
What did you just say?
Um, nothing, nothing! Don't worry about it!
